title: On Connecting the pipe to the old tank
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：connect　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 connect 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the doctor ① connected the pipe to the old tank before dawn, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the doctor ② connects the pipe to the old tank in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ connect the pipe to the old tank at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ connected the pipe to the old tank before — a line in the chart for January 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Connecting the pipe to the old tank before dawn, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ connect the new case with the old in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Connect the new case with the old at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the chart, and a new patient from the next clinic ⑧ connects the new case with the old before dawn every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ connected the pipe to the old tank again when nobody else would.

⑩ To connect the pipe to the old tank, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the clinic remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the clinic forgets, somebody connects the pipe to the old tank in public again and somebody must connect the pipe to the old tank before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 连接（一般过去式 connected the pipe to the old tank：1948 年大夫头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 连接（一般现在 connects the pipe to the old tank：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 连接（不定式 to connect the pipe to the old tank：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 连接（过去完成时 had connected the pipe to the old tank：1942 年一月的病历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 连接（动名词 connecting the pipe to the old tank 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 联系（connect the new case with the old：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去联系把新案子与旧案子连起来）
G. v. 联系（connect the new case with the old：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 连接（后段两处：新来的病人照例 connects the new case with the old，而母亲又一次 connected the pipe to the old tank）

answers.why: connect 意为“连接”，1948 年大夫天没亮就连接把管子接到旧水池上，那是卫生所里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 connected。
connect 意为“连接”，自那以后大夫当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 connects。
connect 意为“连接”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯连接把管子接到旧水池上”，此处为不定式 to connect the pipe to the old tank。
connect 意为“连接”，病历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1955 年之前就有人连接过，故用过去完成时 had connected。
connect 意为“连接”，大夫说“连接把管子接到旧水池上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 connecting the pipe to the old tank 作主语。
connect 意为“联系”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去联系把新案子与旧案子连起来”，should ever 之后用原形 connect the new case with the old。
connect 意为“联系”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻联系把新案子与旧案子连起来（connect the new case with the old at once），以后再也不要提起。
connect 意为“连接”，新来的病人每个星期都照例联系把新案子与旧案子连起来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 connects。
connect 意为“连接”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就连接把管子接到旧水池上，用一般过去式 connected 叙述。
connect 意为“连接”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要连接把管子接到旧水池上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和卫生所记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

多年以后，大夫仍当着众人面做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（connects the pipe to the old tank）

早在 1942 年就有人连接把管子接到旧水池上，一月那天病历上的一行字就是证据。（had connected the pipe to the old tank）
大夫说过，天没亮就连接把管子接到旧水池上这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（connecting the pipe to the old tank 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻联系把新案子与旧案子连起来，以后再也不要提起。（connect the new case with the old，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 connect 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the doctor connected the pipe to the old tank before dawn, and nobody in the clinic forgot it.
Even now the doctor connects the pipe to the old tank in public whenever the clinic asks.
Connecting the pipe to the old tank before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever connect the new case with the old in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new patient from the next clinic connects the new case with the old before dawn every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother connected the pipe to the old tank again, and the clinic remembered that half.
